title: [HW2] Keyboard-driven terminal menu operation (P1)
prompt: Add an interactive keyboard-driven terminal menu (e.g. pick topic / rounds / start / view) over the existing SDK, alongside the current arg-based command. Config-driven; TDD; <=150 lines/file; ruff/mypy/coverage >=85%.
note: HW2 docs/hw2_requirements.pdf §8.6/§8.7 — the project must be operable from a basic keyboard-driven terminal menu (SDK-direct allowed for testing). The CLI was argument-only (agent-debate run TOPIC --rounds/--max-words/--model/--search-backend/--json in packages/cli/). Added packages/cli/src/agent_debate/cli/_menu.py: a thin interactive loop over the EXISTING SDK + live renderer (no duplicated debate logic). DebateChoices NamedTuple (topic/rounds/max_words/model/search_backend); initial_choices(settings) seeds defaults from Settings (no hard-coded values); run_menu(*, io, settings, runner) drives a numbered menu (1 topic, 2 rounds, 3 max-words, 4 model, 5 search, s start, q quit). All terminal I/O goes through an injectable MenuIO Protocol (prompt+echo) and the debate is driven by an injected runner callable, so the loop is unit-testable without a real TTY/engine/key. ScriptedIO is the test double. Registered a `menu` command in app.py wiring _TyperIO (typer.prompt/typer.echo — no new dep) and _menu_runner which reuses _prepare + render_stream + run_or_fail (same SDK path as run, routed through the Epic-13 gatekeeper). _set_int re-prompts/keeps current on non-numeric or non-positive input; start without a topic is refused; verdict rendered via _render_verdict reusing _live_style.side_label. TDD red-first: packages/cli/tests/test_menu.py written first (ModuleNotFoundError) then implementation -> green. Tests cover quit-without-running, defaults shown, set-topic-then-start invokes runner with the choices, set-all-fields override, invalid/zero numeric re-prompt, unknown option warns, runner-returns-None no-verdict, start-blocked-without-topic, menu --help registered, and the full `menu` command driven via stdin script with a fake engine. No new dependency: Typer/stdlib only. Gates green: ruff check + format clean (255 files), mypy clean (252 source files), check_line_limit.py exit 0 (_menu.py 78 code lines, app.py within cap), pytest --cov 96.88% total with _menu.py 100%. No new failures vs clean main: the known pre-existing environmental failures (live-tree secret-scan/hygiene on the developer's real .env, two Windows missing-file path-regex, long-topic parametrized teardown errors, Unix file-permission branch-protection checks) are unchanged. docs/PRD.md NOT touched (PR #214 owns it).
